regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Ribociclib with an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant aims to control advanced HR-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer. The exact endocrine partner depends on previous treatment and menopausal status.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Ribociclib: Ribociclib blocks CDK4 and CDK6, proteins that help cells move through the cycle of division. Endocrine therapy reduces the hormone signal that can drive HR-positive breast cancer. AI or fulvestrant: An aromatase inhibitor (AI) lowers oestrogen production; fulvestrant blocks and reduces oestrogen receptors. These are alternative endocrine partners, selected by the team. Ovarian suppression is needed in pre/perimenopausal patients.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: The usual metastatic starting dose is ribociclib 600 mg once daily on Days 1–21 followed by Days 22–28 off. Continue the prescribed AI daily or fulvestrant on its own injection schedule; add ovarian suppression when indicated. Continue while beneficial and tolerated.
key_points: The usual metastatic starting dose is ribociclib 600 mg once daily on Days 1–21 followed by Days 22–28 off. Continue the prescribed AI daily or fulvestrant on its own injection schedule; add ovarian suppression when indicated. Continue while beneficial and tolerated.

regimen_profiles.title: Ribociclib (Kisqali)

drug_interactions.intro: Reconcile every prescription, over-the-counter medicine and supplement before starting treatment and whenever medicines change. This warning panel is not an automated interaction checker.

groups.title: May increase Kisqali exposure and side effects
groups.mechanism: Some medicines slow the enzyme that clears ribociclib (CYP3A4).
groups.examples: Examples include clarithromycin, itraconazole and ritonavir-containing medicines. Grapefruit and grapefruit juice can also raise exposure.
groups.action: Avoid grapefruit. Ask the oncology pharmacist to check any new prescription, including short courses of antibiotics or antivirals.

groups.title: May reduce Kisqali exposure and effectiveness
groups.mechanism: Some medicines increase CYP3A4 activity, so the body removes ribociclib more quickly.
groups.examples: Examples include rifampicin, carbamazepine, phenytoin and St John’s wort.
groups.action: Avoid St John’s wort. Do not stop prescribed medicines yourself; ask the oncology team to arrange a suitable alternative when needed.

groups.title: May add to heart-rhythm risk
groups.mechanism: Other medicines can also lengthen the heart’s QT interval.
groups.examples: Examples include amiodarone, moxifloxacin and ondansetron. Tamoxifen is not a recommended partner with ribociclib.
groups.action: Check anti-sickness medicines, antibiotics and all other treatments with your team. An example list cannot establish that an unlisted medicine is safe.

groups.title: Kisqali can increase other medicine levels
groups.examples: Some sedatives, pain medicines and other prescriptions may need an alternative, monitoring or dose adjustment.
groups.action: Keep an up-to-date list of prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and herbal products. Tell other prescribers that you take ribociclib.

drug_interactions.clinician_note: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers should be avoided; use current SmPC and an interaction database. If an inhibitor is unavoidable, dose changes and the washout interval require oncology/pharmacy review of the actual ribociclib dose. QT-prolonging drugs add risk. Ribociclib can increase CYP3A4-substrate exposure. Do not infer safety from absence from this example list.

evidence_at_a_glance.trial: NATALEE: primary trial and prespecified six-year descriptive follow-up
evidence_at_a_glance.population: 5,101 adults with HR-positive/HER2-negative stage II–III early breast cancer, including selected high-risk node-negative disease.
evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: Ribociclib 400 mg on Days 1–21 every 28 days for three years plus a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor versus the aromatase inhibitor alone; endocrine therapy for at least five years, with goserelin in men and premenopausal women.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: Adjuvant population; not MONALEESA metastatic evidence. NCCP00892v2 includes selected node-negative eligibility but also a conflicting node-negative exclusion, which still requires clinical reconciliation.
evidence_at_a_glance.qualitative_result: The primary trial established an iDFS benefit. The six-year descriptive analysis continued to favor ribociclib for recurrence outcomes and reported a favorable OS estimate with a nominal P value.

endpoints.metric: Estimated invasive disease-free survival at six years
endpoints.result_text: 83.23% versus 77.92%; difference 5.3 percentage points. HR 0.741 (95% CI 0.646–0.849); nominal one-sided P<.0001.
endpoints.interpretation: The previously established recurrence benefit persisted in longer follow-up.

regimen_profiles.title: Ribociclib (Kisqali)

drug_interactions.intro: Reconcile every prescription, over-the-counter medicine and supplement before starting treatment and whenever medicines change. This warning panel is not an automated interaction checker.

groups.title: May increase Kisqali exposure and side effects
groups.mechanism: Some medicines slow the enzyme that clears ribociclib (CYP3A4).
groups.examples: Examples include clarithromycin, itraconazole and ritonavir-containing medicines. Grapefruit and grapefruit juice can also raise exposure.
groups.action: Avoid grapefruit. Ask the oncology pharmacist to check any new prescription, including short courses of antibiotics or antivirals.

groups.title: May reduce Kisqali exposure and effectiveness
groups.mechanism: Some medicines increase CYP3A4 activity, so the body removes ribociclib more quickly.
groups.examples: Examples include rifampicin, carbamazepine, phenytoin and St John’s wort.
groups.action: Avoid St John’s wort. Do not stop prescribed medicines yourself; ask the oncology team to arrange a suitable alternative when needed.

groups.title: May add to heart-rhythm risk
groups.mechanism: Other medicines can also lengthen the heart’s QT interval.
groups.examples: Examples include amiodarone, moxifloxacin and ondansetron. Tamoxifen is not a recommended partner with ribociclib.
groups.action: Check anti-sickness medicines, antibiotics and all other treatments with your team. An example list cannot establish that an unlisted medicine is safe.

groups.title: Kisqali can increase other medicine levels
groups.examples: Some sedatives, pain medicines and other prescriptions may need an alternative, monitoring or dose adjustment.
groups.action: Keep an up-to-date list of prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and herbal products. Tell other prescribers that you take ribociclib.

drug_interactions.clinician_note: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers should be avoided; use current SmPC and an interaction database. If an inhibitor is unavoidable, dose changes and the washout interval require oncology/pharmacy review of the actual ribociclib dose. QT-prolonging drugs add risk. Ribociclib can increase CYP3A4-substrate exposure. Do not infer safety from absence from this example list.
